# Engine swap: HyperFrames against Motion

One 9-second Magnifito storyboard rendered by both engines, side by side: HyperFrames on the left, the spring-based Motion engine on the right. The brief, brand, copy and scene timing are identical; because Motion only accepts motion-* recipes, each scene uses the closest recipe of each engine (kinetic type, a four-row service layout, a logo end card).

- Type: Engine variation
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes, motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 9.2 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/v03-engine.mp4`](../videos/v03-engine.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to compare the two render engines on one storyboard. Plan a 9.2-second 16:9 Magnifito promo with three scenes: "Great businesses stay invisible online" in big type (3 s), "Grow with Magnifito" with four service lines: websites, social media, email and ads, automation (3.8 s), and the logo with "Marketing with heart and value" (2.4 s). Render it once with engine hyperframes (hyperframes/: kinetic-typography, isometric-feature-grid, brand-title) and once with engine motion (motion/: motion-kinetic-type, motion-card-morph, motion-logo-reveal). Keep the brief, brand, copy and timing identical and change only the engine and the recipes. Put the two renders side by side with mgvideo multicam and label each half in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg).

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- v03-engine
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/v03-engine/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render hyperframes --force
node collect-run.mjs hyperframes/runs work/hyperframes.mp4
mgvideo render motion --force
node collect-run.mjs motion/runs work/motion.mp4
mgvideo multicam work/hyperframes.mp4 work/motion.mp4 --layout side-by-side -o work/side-by-side.mp4
node rasterize.mjs labels.svg work/labels.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/side-by-side.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -an -t 9.2 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/engine.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/engine.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
